name: FindAndReplaceWords
label: Find and Replace Words in Word Document
description: Finds text and replaces it with another in the active document of a Word instance.

fields.name: WordInstance
fields.label: Word Instance
fields.description: The specific Word instance to use.

fields.name: AllMatches
fields.label: All Matches
fields.description: Specifies whether to replace all occurrences or just the first one.

fields.name: TextToFind
fields.label: Text to Find
fields.description: The text to search for in the document.

fields.name: TextToReplaceWith
fields.label: Text to Replace With
fields.description: The text to replace the found text with.

fields.name: UseWildcards
fields.label: Use Wildcards
fields.description: Specifies whether to use wildcard patterns for the search.

fields.name: MatchCase
fields.label: Match Case
fields.description: Specifies whether the search should be case-sensitive.

fields.name: MatchWholeWordsOnly
fields.label: Match Whole Words Only
fields.description: Specifies whether to match whole words only.
